english.note: Use this for an ambitious, large-scale, usually high-budget work or event, even when exceptional popularity is not yet established.

examples.english: This epic stage production is an ambitious blockbuster, with huge sums spent on promotion before opening.
examples.traditional: 呢套史詩式舞台劇係大製作，未公演已經落重本宣傳。
